The m6A methylation status and differential expression status are strongly independent-rejected: the 3×3 chi-squared test of independence (m6A: Hyper/Hypo/no sig × DEG: Up/Down/no-DEGs, N = 12,754 rows, using the pre-computed columns) gives chi2 = 901.45, df = 4, **p ≈ 8.10×10⁻¹⁹⁴** (i.e., 8.10e-194). Sensitivity check: the 2×2 Fisher's exact test collapsing to m6A-sig (Hyper+Hypo) vs no-sig × DEG-sig (Up+Down) vs no-DEGs gives **p ≈ 8.22×10⁻⁵⁴** (8.22e-54, odds ratio 3.94). Both tests overwhelmingly reject independence — m6A methylation status and differential expression status are not independent in this bladder cancer dataset.

Contingency tables:
- 3×3: Hyper [Up 106, Down 12, no-DEGs 562]; Hypo [9, 119, 383]; no sig [433, 284, 10,846].
- 2×2: m6A-sig [DEG-sig 246, no-DEG 945]; m6A-no-sig [717, 10,846].

Limitation: rows are transcript/region-level (9,473 unique transcripts, 3,117 genes; up to 16 rows per transcript), so the row-level test treats clustered observations as independent — noted in the script, no aggregation performed as agreed.
